meta.title: Turn cost
meta.description: Shows what DeepSeek usage costs, in two places. Under every finished answer in the Chat flow a line such as ≈ $0.00516 appears; click it to expand the per-bucket breakdown (input without a cache hit, cached input, cache write, output, each with its effective rate and amount) plus the model and whether the peak or off-peak rate applied. At the bottom of the sidebar, above Settings, a balance panel shows the account wallet and the spend of the open session, always in US dollars: a wallet kept in another currency, such as a yuan top-up, is converted and marked ≈, and the tooltip names every original wallet, the rate applied, and any bonus. Every figure comes from the provider-reported usage of each billed request, recorded by this plugin's own session projection, so the session figure covers the whole session rather than only the part on screen, and each request is priced at the published rate of its own model and of its own instant. The panel re-reads the wallet when the session spends more, when the account changes, on reconnect, and when the window regains focus. Amounts are estimates, not billed charges: prices, peak windows (Beijing time, weekday 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00, Chinese public holidays not modelled), the display currency, and the exchange rate are configuration at the top of client.js in the installed package; a subagent session is counted separately from the session that started it. The plugin sends nothing anywhere and adds no model-visible content.
